title: LRU memoization contract (L40)
description: Allowlist for @lru_cache on hot-path functions. See ADR-057.

invariants.name: allowlist_source_of_truth
invariants.description: Every @lru_cache in waggledance/ MUST be in allowlist.

invariants.name: hashable_args
invariants.description: Function args MUST all be hashable.
must: no @dataclass without slots+frozen as arg type

invariants.name: hot_path_justification
invariants.description: Allowlist entry has justification citing measurement.
must: justification field non-empty on every entry
should reference L34 budget or bench result

invariants.name: reviewable
invariants.description: Adding to allowlist requires PR review + bench.
